assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational.
Asset type: one original school/custodial hazard-recognition scene for exam preparation.
Style/medium: original black monochrome technical line illustration with confident medium contour, sparse functional hatching, restrained interior detail, generous whitespace, and plain civil-service test-booklet economy. This must be a clean line drawing, not a photograph, not photorealistic, not a shaded 3D render, and not color artwork.
Composition/framing: wide 3:2 landscape, low close wall-side view. Show one complete portable floor fan against the gym wall occupying about the left two-fifths. Keep its close-spaced front and rear guards complete. From the fan housing, route one thick but plausible power cord horizontally along the wall edge toward a connected plug and receptacle at right. The cord never enters the walking route. Keep the gym floor dry, level, broad, and completely clear. Do not add mats, storage, doors, people, or other props.
Primary target: immediately outside the fan housing and clearly beyond the intact strain relief, depict one large open split in the black outer cord jacket. The damaged span must occupy at least one-fifth of the image width. Peel the two jacket edges visibly apart so the gap cannot resemble a collar, splice, tape, ferrule, or connector. Inside that one gap, show exactly two separate smooth parallel inner conductors, each retaining complete light neutral-gray insulation outlined in black. Place a clear white gap between the two insulated conductors. Each conductor must visibly continue from intact outer cord on the fan side to intact outer cord on the plug side. No third wire, no bare copper, no frayed strands. Make the cord and its two inner conductors thick enough to remain distinct at a 480-by-320 reduction while keeping mechanically plausible proportions.
Meaning constraint: the large damaged cord jacket is the only hazard. The guard, plug, receptacle, floor, and route are safe as depicted.
Color palette: black, white, and restrained neutral-gray line hatching only. No cue may depend on color.
Absolute exclusions: no inline connector, repair sleeve, tape, strain-relief collar at the damaged span, sparks, smoke, heat, bare metal conductor, wet surface, loose route-crossing cord, missing guard, unstable object, blocked egress, person, text, pseudo-text, readable sign, label, letter, number, arrow, circle, callout, logo, brand, watermark, decorative border, cropped meaning-bearing object, impossible connection, floating part, dramatic spotlighting, inset detail, or visual highlighting of the target.
Output intent: one native raster candidate; do not add annotations or explanatory text.
